title: Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) — Medical Hardship Thresholds and Liquid Asset Test
content:
## Medical hardship figures and the asset test, by tier

The Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) defines three medical hardship figures and an asset test for every tier:

- **Medical debt threshold**: the percent of annual household income that qualifying medical debt must exceed for medical hardship.
- **Debt window**: the integer months before the application date over which qualifying medical debt (Riverbend and outside medical bills) is counted.
- **Liability cap percent**: the percent of annual household income that caps the patient's total liability across all encounters covered by a medical hardship award.
- **Liquid asset test**: whether liquid assets are tested for the tier, and the USD liquid assets (cash, checking, savings, non-retirement brokerage) above which a tier with the asset test is denied.

| Tier | Medical debt threshold | Debt window | Liability cap percent | Asset test applies | Liquid asset limit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Riverbend Presumptive Charity Care | 20.0 percent | 12 months | 10.0 percent | no | 25000.00 USD |
| Riverbend Full Charity Care (0-200% FPL) | 20.0 percent | 12 months | 10.0 percent | no | 25000.00 USD |
| Riverbend 80% Charity Discount (201-250% FPL) | 20.0 percent | 12 months | 10.0 percent | no | 25000.00 USD |
| Riverbend 60% Charity Discount (251-300% FPL) | 20.0 percent | 12 months | 10.0 percent | no | 25000.00 USD |
| Riverbend 40% Charity Discount (301-400% FPL) | 20.0 percent | 12 months | 10.0 percent | no | 25000.00 USD |
| Riverbend Medical Hardship Assistance (above 400% FPL) | 20.0 percent | 12 months | 10.0 percent | yes | 25000.00 USD |

### Notes on the table

- The asset limit is recorded on every tier, but only the Medical Hardship tier tests it; on the other five tiers the figure is not applied.
- "Exceed" and "above" are strict. On hypothetical figures, a household with liquid assets of exactly 25000.00 USD is not above the limit; one with 25000.01 USD is.
